event.reason: Operator-approved CPU-first mathematical architecture roadmap: 11 new independent/matched experiments, dependency-aware and ordered by stated priority while preserving existing discovery-first queue and active NC-022 claim; ranks guide scheduling but never bypass DAG dependencies.

acceptance: Reproducible source/checkpoint hashes and multi-seed held-out question-generation trace with complete accepted/rejected counts, evaluator isolation and no hidden oracle or problem-template leakage.

Real independent verifier checks provenance, question novelty definition, baseline comparability, duplicates, type/domain restrictions, and preservation of prior capabilities. No promotion without verification.
avoid: Do not call syntactically random questions, restated training tasks, or unsupported claims mathematically novel. Finite questions do not imply open-world mathematical understanding.

instruction: Build a bounded self-question generator over verified typed mathematical knowledge, unsolved goals, counterexamples, invariant candidates, contradictions and under-explored abstraction links. Generate questions without receiving a human-written evaluation question list or held-out solution labels at inference. Benchmark on disjoint held-out mathematical families with matched CPU/time budgets versus deterministic gap enumeration, randomized questions and static operator-composition baselines; quantify valid-question rate, diversity, novelty relative to frozen registry and downstream verified solvability. event.title: Generate autonomous mathematical research questions

acceptance: Frozen held-out question pools, no future labels leaked into selection, multi-seed controlled ablations and independently reproducible total CPU/verification accounting.

avoid: Do not optimize only expression count, easy proofs, predicted reward or question novelty; require measured downstream benefit.

instruction: Define a preregistered interest/utility contract for self-generated questions: well-typed validity, novelty relative to a frozen registry, downstream transfer potential, proof feasibility, computational cost, and relation to prior verified abstractions; avoid conflating novelty with usefulness.

event.title: Learn mathematical interestingness and question utility

acceptance: Multi-seed bounded runs containing complete question->proposal->proof/counterexample->revision chains and operator source hashes, with no hidden human steering or retrospective goal changes.

avoid: Do not equate a scripted enumerator with fully autonomous problem formulation or a finite identity with unrestricted theorem discovery.

instruction: Build a bounded, restartable loop using NC-040 questions and NC-041 priorities: observe verified registry, choose question, propose executable candidate/lemma, search, independently check finite/formal scope, store proof or counterexample, revise questions or HALT; persist provenance and failure history.

Do not let host supply the next question, answer, or hidden oracle during the self-directed evaluation; freeze budgets, seed, allowed theorem/operator set, checkpoints and permitted proof tools before each run. Keep candidate execution sandboxed, CPU-limited and deterministic where feasible.

Benchmark autonomous question selection versus human-provided fixed research queues, random and deterministic ranking, and frozen-policy ablations on held-out families. Measure total verification CPU, useful lemma reuse, solved future questions, failed hypotheses, coverage, and restart recovery.
event.title: Close bounded self-directed mathematical research loop

acceptance: Predeclared held-out families, comparable full CPU budgets, independent multi-seed tests, actual model/policy update evidence and complete source/checkpoint provenance.

Different real verifier audits anti-leakage, matched budget, strategy changes, retention and reversible no-promotion outcome.
avoid: Do not label ordinary cache reuse or more search iterations meta-learning without demonstrated strategy adaptation.

instruction: Use only prior, verified discovery traces to update the question-selector/search-strategy policy across research episodes. Preserve frozen initialization, full optimizer/checkpoint/RNG state, exact data splits, replay memory, strategy changes and rollback to previous versions.

Evaluate whether learned strategy changes future *question selection and problem-solving efficiency* on structurally held-out mathematical families; compare frozen policy, static curriculum, learning-progress/cost-aware bandit, random selection and equal-compute retraining controls.

Account for training, inference, verification, hypothesis rejection and registry overhead; measure useful independent discoveries per CPU-second, held-out transfer, search budget to solve, forgetting, negative transfer and strategy adaptation across episodes.
event.title: Demonstrate meta-learning of self-directed research strategy

event.reason: Operator-prioritized scientific autonomy and Level-2 mathematical research: bring prerequisites NC-008/009/023/024/025/026 ahead of question generator NC-040, interestingness NC-041, autonomous research NC-042 and strategy meta-learning NC-043. acceptance: Reproducible path/identity isolation adversarial tests, versioned source/checkpoint SHA-256 manifest and clean restarts; trainer cannot overwrite champion or forge verifier evidence.

Role separation holds across stateless tabs, interrupted jobs and concurrent implementer/verifier sessions.
avoid: Do not assert separate identity based only on prompt labels; no token-heavy agent process is required for a local training job.

instruction: Create a distinct TRAINER role contract and isolated workspace/checkpoint namespace for candidate successors to the exact SHA-256-pinned unified RLT champion, without changing the existing implementer or verifier ownership protocol. Use a real session/worker identity and a separate tracked run ID; do not infer identities from tab names.

Establish separate Git worktree or isolated output directory, versioned input manifest and rollback.

Define CPU, RAM, disk and wall-time quotas plus pause/resume/cancel behavior so training does not starve the discovery worker or desktop. Preserve full optimizer/RNG/data cursor state; test disjoint writable paths, symlink/path-traversal rejection, interruption and restart. No daemon activation or new privileges without explicit authorization.
Pin current champion and NC-022 NO_GAIN evidence; train a candidate successor ONLY, with no claim of improvement until independent matched retention/generalization tests.
